_comment: Trading-stream config for the CFD runner (app.main_ctrader / app.main_cfd_paper).
Rename this file to 'data/cfd_streams.json' to ACTIVATE it (it is then loaded
automatically). While it is named '.example.json' the runner falls back to the
Each stream is fed the SAME strategy signals but executes + reports on its own:
kind=paper : simulated fills, no broker orders (cost-free baseline).
kind=demo  : REAL orders on a cTrader DEMO account.
kind=live  : REAL orders on a funded / prop-firm account.
demo + live read REAL commission/swap from cTrader's close deal (not modeled).
Set enabled=false to turn any stream off. Give a stream its own
telegram_bot_token + telegram_chat_id to send its alerts to a dedicated
channel (e.g. one per prop firm); omit them to share the default CFD channel.
ctrader_account_id targets a specific ctidTraderAccountId (0 = the default
